name: bdf_get_exchange_rate
description:
Daily ECB euro reference rates: units of US dollar, pound sterling, Japanese yen or Chinese yuan per 1 EUR.
Returns: series_code, label, unit, frequency (always reported as % and Daily), observation_count and observations (date, value).
Inputs (* required): currency_pair* (eur_usd, eur_gbp, eur_jpy, eur_cny; schema default eur_usd); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; keeps the last N observations, only when no date is given).
ecb_get_exchange_rate covers any currency the ECB quotes. Despite the bdf_ name, data comes from the legacy ECB statistical web service (sdw-wsrest.ecb.europa.eu), no API key; the ecb_ tools read the same ECB data from the current ECB Data Portal API.
Example: {"currency_pair": "eur_usd", "recent_periods": 20}
